title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：strength　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strength 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the athlete ① built the strength that no trainer in the stadium would have counted, and he said the building was the whole of the year. The ② strength, meaning the power itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; strength, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of strength in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ strength at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Strength, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the athlete said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the strength was the whole of the matter, meaning the will and not the power. The ⑥ strength, meaning the will and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; strength, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both power and a will. He said the will is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ strength had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ strength of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of counting; strength, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ strength I remember is the strength counted in the programme, which closed in 1960 and is still counted as the quietest in the stadium. ⑩ Strength, my mother said in 1962, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all strength, she said, is a will that has agreed to look like power. She said the will was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 力量；长处（指体育场里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 力量；长处（指那分力量本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the strength 练这一分力量
D. n. 力量；长处（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 力量之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的力量之事）
F. n. 力量；长处（指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一分）
G. n. 力量、心劲（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心劲（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the strength that no trainer in the stadium would have counted
The strength, meaning the power itself and not the bib
Every sort of strength in that stadium
the strength at the far track
the strength was the whole of the matter
the strength had become a line in a programme
The strength of the whole thing

answers.why: build the strength 意为“练这一分力量”，1953 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯清点的一分力量做了一遍。
strength 意为“力量；长处”，指那分力量本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
strength 意为“力量；长处”，指体育场里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
strength 意为“力量；长处”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
strength 意为“力量、心劲”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分心劲就是那件事的全部。
strength 意为“心劲”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分力量，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
strength 意为“力量；长处”，指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一分，到 1958 年这一分成了秩序册里的一行。
strength 意为“力量之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的力量之事是一处体育场和三个年份的清点。
strength 意为“力量；长处”，我记得的是秩序册里清点过的那一分，1960 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一分。
strength 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，力量是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的力量。
